scope: source-authority FX equivalents, currency-safe decision outputs, and compatibility-preserving financial hardening
key_changes: Expose source-reported FX purchase EUR/IRR equivalents and explicit coverage without cross-currency native aggregation
Expose source-reported Credit EUR/IRR equivalents with LC-level snapshot deduplication and conflict quarantine
Value NTSW commitment balance only from same-REG same-currency source evidence and expose the exact valuation basis
Never borrow an FX rate from another registration or another currency
Use NTSW Allocation rate only as a same-case same-currency IRR fallback when purchase evidence is unavailable

Add EUR/IRR equivalent decision views to Studio, dashboard, Excel, HTML/process views while preserving legacy column/card contracts
